issues.display_title: Issue #1061: Research on Flow Insert cc_purchase for Recurring Payments After the First Payment in Old GoThru
issues.main_description_html:
Overview

Architectural research on how recurring subscription payments after the initial checkout were tracked and persisted into ccdb.cc_purchase in legacy GoThru, and how this flow is standardized in GoThru-API-New:

  1. Initial vs Recurring Payment Separation:
    • Initial checkout transactions (checkout_session, direct purchase) are recorded immediately by controller actions upon webhook or payment gateway response.
    • Subsequent billing renewals (cycles after the first payment) do not re-run user-initiated checkout actions. Instead, legacy GoThru used cronjob polling and webhook listeners to sweep recurring transactions.
  2. Current Standardized Helpers (App\Http\Controllers\Cronjobs\Helpers\):
    • RecordStripeRecurringTransactionsHelper: Iterates through active subscriptions (sub_* and cus_*), parses recurring invoices (invoice.lines.data), filters renewal cycles (billing_reason = subscription_cycle), inserts missing cc_purchase rows (date_purchase, amount, transid), logs to cc_logs_stripe, and triggers prepareInvoiceData().
    • RecordPaypalRecurringTransactionsHelper: Processes recurring sales, parses recurring_profile identifiers, records to cc_purchase, and dispatches Plunk invoices.
    • RecordPayflowRecurringTransactionsHelper: Evaluates Payflow recurring profiles.

issues.display_title: Issue #1211: Refactor API Download Stitch Files on Google Drive
issues.main_description_html:
Architectural Overview

Complete refactoring of the Google Drive image downloading endpoint for stitching into the standard Action-Domain-Responder (ADR) architecture:

  1. Route Mapping & Middleware (routes/stitchingRoutes.php):
    • Registered under /stitching with auth middleware: POST /stitching/download-google-drive $\rightarrow$ Stitching\DownloadGoogleDriveController@handle.
  2. Dedicated Modular Flow:
    • Controller (DownloadGoogleDriveController): Receives HTTP request, runs input validation via DownloadGoogleDriveValidator, constructs DownloadGoogleDriveDto, delegates business logic to DownloadGoogleDriveAction, and formats response envelope using ResponseEnvelopeHelper::encryptResult().
    • Validator (DownloadGoogleDriveValidator): Enforces type-safe parameter validation (moderation_id integer, access_token string, image_id string).
    • Action (DownloadGoogleDriveAction):
      • Ownership Verification: Confirms moderation ownership via ToursRepository::checkModerationOwnership(), throwing ModerationNotOwnerException (409) if unauthorized.
      • Target Directory Resolution: Ensures target folder exists on disk (/data/moderation/{USER_ID}/stitching/{MID}/).
      • Single-Pass Download Optimization: Employs single HTTP stream request to Google Drive (https://www.googleapis.com/drive/v3/files/{id}?alt=media), extracting original filename directly from HTTP Content-Disposition headers (with metadata fallback).
      • In-Memory MIME Validation: Uses finfo(FILEINFO_MIME_TYPE) directly on downloaded memory buffers to validate allowed image MIME types (image/jpeg, image/png, image/gif, image/webp) before writing to disk, preventing malicious or invalid file uploads.
      • Safe File Persistence: Writes validated binary content directly to the destination path.
